create_collision_shape: create a collision shape for a sphere or box geometry using pybullet createCollisionShape
create_multibody: create a physics multibody from a collision shape with a specified position and orientation
get_closest_points: query the closest points between two collision shapes or bodies within a given distance
get_quaternion_from_euler: convert Euler angle yaw pitch roll values into a quaternion orientation for a body
add_user_debug_line: draw a colored debug line between two 3D points to visualize collision contact points
